rows.title: Award level outlay reporting covers under one per cent of obligations
rows.executor: DFAS Columbus, Navy FMO, OUSD(C)
rows.note: THE AUDIT FINDING VISIBLE IN PUBLIC DATA. Outlay reporting covers 0.80 per cent of 9,097.9M obligated and 2114 reports zero. This is the Fund Balance with Treasury weakness appearing in the public record rather than in an audit report. Standing consequence until closed: no cost product may take outlays for this hull from the public spending record.

rows.note: Full contract population, built outward from the ship rather than inward from the documents. PSC 1901, acquisition program code 223, funding office N30270.

rows.title: Two contracts carried as General Atomics. Neither is this hull, one is not that vendor
rows.executor: FPDS-NG PIID search or USAspending award page
rows.note: Two PIIDs carried as General Atomics. Neither attribution held. N00024-18-C-4100 is VERICOR POWER SYSTEMS LLC, 19,169,760 FFP signed 2017-11-22, for an ETF40B power producer group assembly on LCAC 86, a landing craft and not this hull. N00024-14-C-4201 is absent from both the awardfull and IDV indexes. A control query on N0002409C2116 returned a complete record from the same feed in the same session, which is what makes the absence a finding rather than a feed failure. The gap had stood open on an inherited vendor label that no one had tested.
